NASA The Space Shuttle reference page: Shuttle Basics Length 184 feet — dimensions

The reusable orbiter, external tank, and twin solid rocket boosters that flew 135 missions between 1981 and 2011. Built the ISS, deployed and serviced Hubble, and demonstrated the engineering trade-offs of a partially-reusable crewed launcher.
First spacecraft to orbit Jupiter; atmospheric probe into Jupiter clouds
Most complete radar map of Venus — 98% of the surface at ~120-m resolution; first planetary spacecraft launched from the Space Shuttle
Only spacecraft ever to enter a high-inclination heliocentric orbit; only direct measurements of the solar wind at all heliographic latitudes
First Jupiter orbiter; 8 years of measurements
First spacecraft to observe the Sun's poles from above + below the ecliptic — Jupiter gravity assist 1992
1970s NASA outer-planet workhorse — Pioneer 10/11, Helios 1/2, Mariner 9/10, Pioneer Venus
Lifted Apollo 7, Skylab crews, and ASTP
Reusable, hydrogen-fuelled, and still flying on SLS
